summary: Ellington Credit Company filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a monthly common dividend of $0.08 per share, payable August 31, 2026 to shareholders of record July 31, 2026. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation characteristics such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. The registrant is the issuer. No deal terms apply.
